completion_semantics: research_engine_complete means the autonomous Train-to-Final-Holdout lifecycle, certified challenger bridge, post-certification competition quarantine, and feedback isolation are wired and integrity checks pass; it does not assert that a strategy has passed Final Holdout or accumulated enough live-like title evidence.

checks.name: train_only_memory
checks.detail: adaptive memory must be TRAIN_ONLY with validation/holdout feedback disabled

checks.name: final_holdout_not_leaked
checks.detail: daily adaptive snapshot must never open Final Holdout itself

checks.name: bottleneck_observer_complete
checks.detail: bottleneck_symbols=20 policy=OBSERVATION_ONLY: validation/holdout diagnostics must not feed candidate generation or train-memory adaptation

checks.name: one_shot_final_holdout_registered
checks.detail: final holdout must be durably reserved before read, one-shot, promotion-gated, immutable, and feedback-isolated

checks.name: post_certification_title_evidence_isolated
checks.detail: title changes may use only a common market window strictly after certification/Final Holdout
